To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the tensor field representation for the vector mesons is a viable option for the description of low-energy Goldstone boson interactions; the chiral Lagrangean formulated with the vector mesons in this representation provides an adequate description of Goldstone bosonic scattering up to energies of about 1.3 GeV.
the flavor SU( 3) chiral model with vector mesons, in the tensor field formulation, provides a good description of the empirical phase shifts in the s and p waves up to about 1200 MeV.
